title: Re-arm completion-ready publication after background persistence becomes durable
outcome: A notifier that runs before its completion is persisted retries promptly once original durable custody is available, preserving bounded attempts and ordinary fallback.
acceptance: A behavioral control with the real asynchronous persist path shows an early not-durable notification attempt cannot emit a hint and later original durability prompts a bounded authenticated notification without waiting solely for the periodic fallback; original requester custody and bounded work remain unchanged.
